text:
Ethan: Quick one  guest arriving ~2:50pm with a folding stroller and a well-behaved service dog. Also a catering box with chilled salads that needs refrigeration. Can someone pre-print a temp badge and confirm fridge space?
Front Desk: Noted Ethan. Badge printing OK. We have one small fridge in pantry (marked 'perishables')  how long will it need to stay chilled?
Ethan: Likely 90 mins. It's from a local spot, needs to stay under 5C. Also would prefer it not be on top shelf (hard for the guest to reach).
Facilities: Pantry fridge is fine for short-term. We'll move any sodas out and clear the middle shelf. If fridge space is tight we can use the small events cooler with ice packs.
PackageBot: Package logged: 1x "GreenFork Catering - Mixed Salads" for Ethan. Courier: BikeCourier Co. Status: at front desk.
Nina: I can swing by at 2:40pm to help move the stroller and carry the box to the fridge.
Ethan: Huge thanks Nina! Also can we reserve the high-back armchair by the window for the guest? It's quieter and has an outlet for the service dog's cooling mat.
Leo: Heads-up the armchair has a small rip (sewing kit in supplies if needed). If you'd rather I can put a throw blanket over it.
Ethan: Throw blanket sounds perfect  thanks Leo. @Front Desk please add a "Reserved 2:45-4:30pm - guest" sticky.
Front Desk: Badge queued (white lanyard): "Ethan - Visitor". Fridge shelf cleared and box can go in middle shelf at arrival. We'll DM a photo of the badge and fridge placement.
PeopleOpsBot: Friendly reminder: service animals are welcome; please avoid feeding other people's animals. See policy link: https://redwood.example/policies/service-animals
Ethan: Acknowledged. Small poll: reserve the armchair? :thumbsup: yes | :thumbsdown: no
Nina: :thumbsup: yes, short visit.
Leo: :thumbsup: yes.
Front Desk: Package placed in fridge middle shelf and labeled "GreenFork - Ethan - perishable". Badge printed and left at desk. DM sent.
Ethan: You're all amazing  appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll collect the badge at 2:45 and meet Nina by the elevator for stroller help. :sparkles:
